    od

    let words = republican.split([' '])
    let year_text = words[words.count - 1]
    let year = int.parse(year_text)

        fi

    return epoch.add_days(cast(days + day_of_year))

    "{date.day} {gregorian_months[date.month - 1]} {date.year}"
